Assignment 4 — Tree & Graph Visualizations

Dataset: Shopify E-Commerce Sales · 60,000 orders · Source: Kaggle (hamzaansari08/shopify-sales-dataset-ml-eda)

🌳 TREE VISUALIZATION

Layout 1: Top-Down Hierarchical

A 3-level directed tree: Shopify Store → Country → Product Category → Traffic Source. Nodes are coloured by level; edge width is uniform (structural containment). Labels shown for levels 0–2.

🌀 TREE VISUALIZATION

Layout 2: Radial / Kamada-Kawai

The same hierarchy rendered using a spring-force algorithm. Countries with similar category/traffic mixes cluster together spatially.

🔗 GRAPH VISUALIZATION

Layout 1: Bipartite Two-Column

Countries (left) connected to Payment Methods (right). Edge width ∝ order count. Top-5 heaviest edges are annotated with exact order counts.

🌐 GRAPH VISUALIZATION

Layout 2: Force-Directed Spring

Spring layout pulls nodes with heavier connections closer together. Node size ∝ total orders. Edge colour (plasma scale) ∝ order count.
